root_idea.summary: The root centers on قول, articulated speech or an utterance.
root_idea.development: From the basic act of speaking, the lexicon develops meanings for a saying or statement, inwardly conceived speech, authoritative pronouncement, forms of eloquence, and several derived terms connected with speech and its content.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized Form I citation form قَالَ.
Distinct Form V verb meaning to fabricate speech.
أَقَاوِيل is the plural of قَوْل and is represented under the normalized nominal headword قَوْل.
Distinct active participle, normalized as قَائِل.
Distinct nominal form قِيل, explicitly treated as a saying or statement.

senses.definition: To say, speak, utter, or express a word, proposition, or statement.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a word, a complete proposition, a command, or a sound signifying something. The form includes ordinary speech, reported speech, and assertions, without making grammatical voice or tense a separate lexical sense.

senses.definition: To entertain or formulate an unspoken thought or saying in the mind.
senses.usage_conditions: This use describes what is conceived inwardly before being expressed aloud; the Quranic context explicitly locates the saying in the speakers' selves.

senses.definition: To communicate, command, or bring about something by a divine pronouncement, inspiration, or imposed response rather than ordinary audible address.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies the verb to inspired direction and to created beings responding through divine subjection; the expression need not describe ordinary human speech heard by an addressee.

senses.definition: To fabricate or make up speech, especially to falsely attribute a statement to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran this describes inventing a saying and falsely presenting it as authoritative or revealed speech.

senses.definition: An utterance, saying, speech, statement, word, or expressed proposition.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage it may denote a single word or a complete statement, and may refer to the speech of a person, messenger, or its ultimate source. It can also name the claim or matter expressed by speech. The plural أَقَاوِيل in 69:44 denotes sayings or claims; the associated fabrication is expressed by تَقَوَّلَ.

senses.definition: A binding divine pronouncement or decree whose fulfillment has become certain.
senses.usage_conditions: In expressions such as حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ, قول denotes the divine determination or word established against a people, rather than merely an audible utterance.

senses.definition: One who says or speaks; a speaker.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the regular active-participle sense of the supplied form, including a person who voices or conveys a saying.
قِيل is a nominal counterpart of قَوْل in the supplied lexical evidence and may denote a statement or saying in general.

other_classical_meanings.definition: With different prepositions, to address someone; report or narrate from someone; speak or judge concerning someone or something; falsely attribute a statement to someone; or assert a doctrine or position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are conventional prepositional constructions, including قَالَ لَهُ, قَالَ عَنْهُ, قَالَ فِيهِ, قَالَ عَلَيْهِ, and قَالَ بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak against someone or vituperate him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized use of the phrase قَالَ فِيهِ and is distinct from merely saying something about someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter, recite, compose, or versify poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The poetic form of the utterance is part of the meaning in this construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To signal or communicate by a gesture, including with the eyes, head, or hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The gesture is understood as conveying a message without necessarily involving spoken words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In idiomatic body-part or object constructions, to take with the hand, walk or strike with the foot, raise a garment, pour water onto an arm or hand, or strike a hand against something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These meanings belong to the cited idiomatic constructions with بِيَدِهِ, بِرِجْلِهِ, بِثَوْبِهِ, and بِالْمَاءِ, rather than to ordinary unmarked speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exercise authority or jurisdiction over someone or something; to arbitrate or assume control.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is اِقْتَالَ عَلَيْهِ or اِقْتَالَ عَلَيْهِمْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To say something that brings or draws good or evil upon oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized use is reported with the expression اِقْتَالَ قَوْلًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A doctrine, belief, or position that one professes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the use of قول for an adopted view, as in saying or holding the doctrine of a particular authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An indication or sign by which something is signified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension from speech to what conveys meaning or points to something else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show sincere concern for, stand by, or take genuine care of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized use is expressed by قَالَ بِكَذَا in the cited lexical discussion and is distinct from merely asserting a belief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An extended verbal composition such as a poem, sermon, or similar speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can be applied to the composition as a whole because it is constituted by speech, without making the reciter its author.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In logic, the definition or delimitation of a thing or category.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a technical usage, such as قول الجوهر and قول العرض, and is not ordinary speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A king or ruling title among the kings of Himyar; one whose word is relied upon and followed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The title is explained in relation to authority resting on the person's word and to succession from a father.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow or take after one's father.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This derived use is associated with the title قَيْل and its inherited authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saying or report that is spread or circulated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This nominal use is distinct from the ordinary verb قَالَ and from the agent noun قَائِل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A speaker or utterer, used in place of قَائِل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may stand for the agent who says something, while قَوْل remains the saying itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saying or piece of speech that is circulated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the feminine nominal form in the expression القَالُ والقَالَةُ لِمَا يُنْشَرُ مِنَ القَوْلِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacious, copious in speech, perspicuous or eloquent in expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related expression ابن أَقْوَال refers to a man who talks much.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thing said; the content or object of an utterance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This denotes what is expressed in constructions such as قَالَ كَذَا and يُقَالُ كَذَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tongue, as the instrument of speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an anatomical and lexical designation, not a verbal form meaning to speak.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In logic, the ten categories or predicaments: substance, quantity, quality, relation, place, time, posture, possession, action, and passion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a technical logical expression.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Grammatical restriction on the objective complement of قَالَ.
Judging or exercising judgment in قال فيه.
Lying or falsely speaking against someone.
Saying something about a person or thing.
Lying against someone is covered by the Quran-attested fabrication sense.
Difficulty of diction or speech adds no separate branch.
Pointer to examples without an independent lexical statement.
A talkative man is covered by the broader speech-quality meaning.

cautions: The Form I QAC group combines many persons, aspects, voices, and imperative forms; the public headword is the normalized citation form قَالَ, and these grammatical variants are not separate senses.
أَقَاوِيل is merged under قَوْل as its plural, while قِيل and قَائِل remain separate public forms because they are distinct nominal formations.
The internal QAC form identity for قِيل is retained as a nominal form; no Lane historical citation has been converted into a modern verse location.
